title: Certify common-base invoice order over every power exponent
body:
A concave-order screen can be inconclusive even when a proposed invoice is worse for every power tariff. This adds an exact comparator for differences whose uncancelled ranks are powers of one integer. With x=b^t, it classifies the signed polynomial over the whole open interval1<x<b. It distinguishes strict order, isolated equality and actual crossings, including repeated and endpoint roots.

This completes the supported all-exponent question; it does not sample t. For example, the inconclusive difference1+4^t-2*2^t is strictly positive for every0<t<1. The related difference9+4*4^t-12*2^t has one interior equality, while2*2^t-3 crosses zero. Paid terms and target debits use the existing strict invoice schema, with exact input-byte hashes.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/compare_power_polynomial.py OLD.json NEW.json
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_power_polynomial.py' -v
```

[Implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c58c57143cc322eb0d578162e6df87ac0f4cd1f/scripts/compare_power_polynomial.py), [proof and limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c58c57143cc322eb0d578162e6df87ac0f4cd1f/docs/research/power-polynomial-comparison.md), [independent tests](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c58c57143cc322eb0d578162e6df87ac0f4cd1f/tests/test_research_power_polynomial.py).

Validation: all343 quadratics with coefficients-3..3 agree with an independent extrema/monotone-interval oracle;288 factored polynomials check known multiplicities and endpoints. Further controls cover irrational roots, degree29, target debits, cancellation, large counts and unsupported inputs. Seven standard-library tests pass on Python3.14.7 and registered3.12.14 with isolated optimized execution. An optional SymPy1.14.0 root-isolation oracle checks64 more cases, including24 dense degree29 polynomials near the count limit; all eight tests pass in that temporary environment. The optional oracle is skipped when SymPy is absent; the tool has no such dependency. All ten existing comparator tests and `git diff --check` pass. A declared edit of the complete selected invoice also demonstrates the inconclusive-to-strict transition.

This is classical Sturm theory with an invoice reduction, not a new root-count theorem. Credit Philippe Pebay, J. Maurice Rojas and David C. Thompson's [endpoint treatment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.07904), and the existing comparator, zxv, mightyOil's T16 audit and credited predecessors. [PR5732](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5732) handles arbitrary ranks at one rational exponent; [PR5731](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5731) provides concave witnesses. They are complementary, unmerged dependencies are not imported, and their source files are unchanged. New implementation, proof and checks: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Scope: ranks must share an integer base after cancellation. The existing rank limit10^9 bounds degree by29. This checks declared arithmetic; it does not authenticate a circuit, detect a missing source charge, prove ownership/native legality or admit a compiler or kappa. No selected-frontier change. Independent human/kernel review and full selected theorem replay were not run. Full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI is pending; existing main navigation failures are already covered by PR5659/5703.
